durableFields.notes: Existing turn-resource field owns the current-turn spell-slot action economy commitment for slotted action spells.
Existing character battle spell-slot state owns slotted attack/save spell expenditure.
Existing combatant Hit Point field owns spell Attack and save-gated damage.
Existing active Spell Effect state owns Hit Point regain prevention, next Attack Roll Advantage, and Opportunity Attack denial admissions.
Public discovery route events project existing subject, hole, target-shape, and action/spell-slot owner facts for qRoute replay.
Public resolution route events project existing fill, hole, Hit Point, Attack Roll, saving throw, and active-effect owner facts for qRoute replay.

notes: Task 4 introduced no top-level BattleState, BattleCreatureState, or character battle resource fields.
qRoute target replay evidence is derived from public battle reducer routeEvents emitted by packages/battle-runtime/src/battle-reducer/reducer-route.ts and observed in the focused MBT harness.

The selected spell identities remain fixture/catalog inputs. Production routing uses action spell procedure, fill kind, target-shape facts, spell-slot invocation facts, and typed active-effect deltas.
Production runtime does not dispatch on QNT branch names, selected spell ids, selected spell names, or route connector names.
